_comment: Researched 2026-11-19. The official title is Final Fantasy VII Revelation, revealed at Summer Game Fest in June 2026 (VGC, Game Informer, Siliconera). It was first given as Spring 2027. The exact date, April 8, 2027, was announced at the September 2026 State of Play: the Square Enix news post is titled 'Final Fantasy VII Revelation launches on April 8, 2027', and RPGSite and GamesRadar agree. It launches the same day on PS5, Xbox Series X|S, Nintendo Switch 2 and PC. From trailers and press: Cid Highwind and Vincent Valentine are newly playable (Vincent's Galian Beast form), the party flies the Highwind airship, the game starts at the North Crater (TGS demo: Whirlwind Maze), and Mideel, Wutai and the Northern Continent are regions. The rest of the party, the villains and the Shinra and Turks names carry over from Remake and Rebirth. The voice actors are the Remake/Rebirth English cast; Revelation's cast has not been officially confirmed, but they are all weak words anyway. Original FF7 and Remake series names are in aliases (FF7, FFVII, FF7R), because the trilogy follows the original story and its spoilers are this game's spoilers. Weak words: Cloud, Rude, Holy, Meteor, Avalanche, Turks, Lifestream and Mako are ordinary words or names of other things (the Colorado Avalanche, Reno, Nevada). Zack, Vincent and Elena are common first names. Cid is in nearly every Final Fantasy and El Cid. Highwind is also Kain's surname in FF4. Hojo, Tseng and Shinra are real surnames, and Shinra is also in Fire Force. Cait Sith is folklore. Revelation is an ordinary word (not an alias). Every voice actor is weak. Accounts: finalfantasyvii is Square Enix's official FF7 Remake account, listed on finalfantasy.com's official accounts page; its bio carries the Revelation date. FinalFantasy is left out because it posts about the whole series. Press text also mentions an 'FFVIIR_CLOUD' account, which I could not verify, so it is left out.
name: Final Fantasy VII Revelation
platforms: PS5, Xbox Series X|S, Nintendo Switch 2, PC
